tutorial.step1.title: Welcome, Pilot!
tutorial.step1.text: Your mission is to take off from the YELLOW planet and land on the RED planet.
tutorial.step2.title: Controls
tutorial.step2.text: Use UP and DOWN arrows for thrust (forward/backward) and LEFT and RIGHT to rotate.
tutorial.step3.title: Be Careful!
tutorial.step3.text: Shields protect you from strong collisions. If your shields run out, a hard crash will be fatal!
tutorial.step4.title: Good Luck!
tutorial.step4.text: Now, land safely on the red planet. Press 'LET'S GO' to begin.
